title: Career Roadmap · Dress Maker
summary: A Dress Maker measures, cuts, stitches, alters and finishes garments, transforming fabric and patterns into clothing for individual customers, boutiques or apparel manufacturers.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 8 may qualify for the DGT ITI Dress Making trade; Class 10 or 12 can broaden further-study options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: No specific Class 11–12 stream is generally required for the ITI route.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Sewing, garment construction, measurements, pattern drafting, textiles and fashion.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Precision, hand coordination, creativity, basic mathematics and customer communication.

blocks.label: Year 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Measurements, hand stitches, seams, fabric types and sewing-machine safety.

blocks.label: Year 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Pattern drafting, cutting, stitching, fitting, alterations and finishing.

blocks.label: Year 3 — Advanced practice
blocks.text: Complex garments, quality control, production efficiency and industry experience.

blocks.label: Year 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Build a garment portfolio, learn costing and prepare for jobs, further study or self-employment.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Previous academic qualifications, language proficiency where required, program-specific prerequisites and portfolio for some design courses. Confirm current program availability and admission requirements through official institution websites.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Dress Maker, Tailor, Sample Machinist, Alterations Specialist, Sewing Machine Operator and Garment Production Assistant.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Apparel manufacturing, fashion studios, tailoring services, costume production and textile businesses.

blocks.label: Typical pathway

blocks.text: Direct employment depends on experience, employer requirements and local work authorization. Visa sponsorship is not guaranteed.

Student ↓ Dress Making Trainee ↓ Tailoring / Sewing Assistant ↓ Dress Maker / Sample Maker ↓ Senior Tailor / Pattern Specialist ↓ Production Supervisor / Boutique Manager ↓ Boutique Owner / Garment Entrepreneur

CLASS 8 / 10 / 12, AS REQUIRED ↓ ITI DRESS MAKING / SEWING TRAINING ↓ MEASUREMENT + PATTERN + STITCHING SKILLS ↓ GARMENT PROJECTS + PORTFOLIO ↓ APPRENTICESHIP / TAILORING EXPERIENCE ↓ DRESS MAKER / GARMENT INDUSTRY JOB ↓ SPECIALIZATION OR FURTHER STUDY ↓ SENIOR ROLE / BOUTIQUE / OWN BUSINESS

Verify current official notifications for admissions, scholarships, course recognition and international requirements. Prioritize garment quality, accurate fitting, practical experience and cost-effective production.
